statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2026-0190 is unsoundness in anyhow::Error::downcast_mut, triggered by calling downcast_mut on an Error that had context added. anyhow 1.0.102 is compiled into rust-analyzer, but the affected function is never called: among the crates reachable from the two shipped binaries, only load-cargo, project-model and rust-analyzer depend on anyhow (the other dependents, lsp-server, xtask and the wit-* and wasm-metadata crates, are not reachable from them), and no Rust source file anywhere in the src/tools/rust-analyzer workspace of Rust 1.100.0 contains a downcast_mut call (1484 files searched). downcast_mut is generic, so its code exists in a binary only if something instantiates it. Advisory: https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0190.html

RUSTSEC-2026-0190 is unsoundness in anyhow::Error::downcast_mut in versions before 1.0.103, triggered by calling downcast_mut on an Error that had context added. anyhow 1.0.100 is compiled into Kapacitor, but the affected function is not used: the only crates in the compiled dependency graph that depend on anyhow are flux and flux-core, and no source file in libflux of flux v0.201.0 calls downcast_mut (the calls to downcast and downcast_ref that exist in libflux act on std panic payloads, not on anyhow errors). The Error::context and with_context calls in libflux are in the fluxdoc binary and in the doc module, which belong to the `doc` feature that Kapacitor does not build. downcast_mut is a generic function, so its code is only emitted when something instantiates it, and the unstripped amd64 kapacitord binary has no symbol containing downcast_mut, while it does contain the anyhow symbols that the flux crates use. Advisory: https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0190.html
